name: MOtion Human Parsing (MOHP) Benchmark
description: Human parsing is one of the most fundamental tasks in analyzing humans and has huge potentials in upper-level applications. Since the introduction of 3D sensors, 3D human parsing has attracted increasing attention. Unfortunately, existing datasets lack motion data and have limited semantic annotations, such as sparse annotations and insufficient label categories. To tackle this issue, we propose a point cloud dataset, MOtion Human Parsing(MOHP), containing 28,800 RGB-D images and 7,200 color point clouds of moving humans with accurate point-wise semantic annotations, captured by 4 synchronized depth cameras at a speed of 15 frames per second. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first color motion human point cloud dataset for 3D human parsing.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use in 3D human parsing and motion understanding research.
notes: Requires 3D mesh/sequence data and temporal evaluation; relatively specialized and smaller-scale compared to large 2D parsing datasets. Evaluation emphasizes part-level segmentation and temporal consistency.
